evals.name: fresh-api-pentest-with-roe-gate
evals.prompt: Let's do a backend API pentest for our mobile app. Create the workspace.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds an engagement directory with a scope subdirectory. Creates engagement root AGENTS.md, scope-level ROE.md (gate enforced), scope AGENTS.md, and first plan directory only after ROE is acknowledged.
expectations: Engagement root AGENTS.md is created with engagement-agents-template
Scope directory is created under engagement
ROE.md is created from template if missing
Plan directory is NOT created until ROE gate is satisfied
User is informed why the gate exists and what to do next
Scope-level AGENTS.md is created with correct structure
All subdirectories (evidence, audit, findings, notes) are created for the plan

evals.name: add-scope-to-existing-engagement
evals.prompt: Add a mobile app pentest scope to the existing engagement.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing engagement root, creates new scope directory with ROE.md template, enforces hard gate, and updates engagement AGENTS.md scope list.
expectations: Does NOT recreate engagement root if it exists
New scope directory is created under engagement
ROE.md is created from template for the new scope
Plan directory is NOT created until ROE gate is satisfied
Engagement root AGENTS.md scope list is updated
Scope-level AGENTS.md is created

evals.name: add-plan-to-existing-scope
evals.prompt: Add a new plan for authentication testing to the existing api-pentest scope.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing ROE.md, skips the gate, creates plans/02-auth-testing/ with all subdirectories and plan.md.
expectations: Does NOT recreate ROE.md if it already exists
Auto-increments plan number to 02
Updates scope-level AGENTS.md plans table with the new plan
Creates all required subdirectories

evals.name: standalone-single-scope
evals.prompt: Start a standalone infrastructure audit of a single server.
evals.expected_output: Creates a single scope directory without an engagement wrapper. Enforces ROE gate. Creates scope AGENTS.md and plan after ROE confirmed.
expectations: No engagement root directory is created
Scope directory is created directly
ROE.md is created and gate enforced
Scope-level AGENTS.md is created
Plan scaffolding happens only after ROE gate

evals.name: evidence-and-audit-standards-enforced
evals.prompt: We're testing a web app and found an XSS vulnerability. Document the finding.
evals.expected_output: Creates a finding record using references/finding-template.md with all required fields including Retest Instructions, and references at least one evidence file.
expectations: Finding is created in findings/ directory
Finding references at least one evidence file
Finding includes 'Retest Instructions' section with exact reproduction steps
Evidence template structure is used (commands, output, timestamp, environment)
Agent does NOT continue testing without documenting the finding
